en: Colorized vintage view over a European city from a hillside covered in dense green vegetation. On the right is a gravel path with stairs, terrace, pergola, railing, and a building façade; on the left is a panoramic view of red‑roofed houses, church towers, and a river with a bridge crossing it. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors, giving an early 20th‑century postcard look. At the top left is printed text indicating the location.
